title: Add GPT-6 Astra xhigh profile
body:
Adds `gpt-6-astra-xhigh` as an independent profile selecting upstream `gpt-6-astra` with `xhigh` reasoning effort. Existing `gpt-6-astra` and the `astra` alias keep `high`. The new profile works through CLI/App launchers, runner/preflight discovery, install/sync and sandbox subscription routing; English/Chinese docs and the sub-agents provider table are updated.

Validation: 157 tests passed, 10 existing opt-in kernel tests skipped; syntax, skill validation and diff checks passed. Independent parallel Deepreviews through Claude `mimo` and `ds-flash` found no substantive issue; controller adjudication is in `docs/work-units/gpt-6-astra-xhigh/adjudication.md`.

No live sync or real model request was performed. After manual merge, sync skills, agent tools and Codex configuration from the approved checkout, reload interactive launchers and reopen Agent sessions. Live deployment requires user authorization.
